title: Google\Cloud\Dlp\V2\HybridInspectStatistics
name: HybridInspectStatistics
description: Statistics related to processing hybrid inspect requests.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.processed_count
params.description: The number of hybrid inspection requests processed within this job.

params.name: data.aborted_count
params.description: The number of hybrid inspection requests aborted because the job ran out of quota or was ended before they could be processed.

params.name: data.pending_count
params.description: The number of hybrid requests currently being processed. Only populated when called via method getDlpJob. A burst of traffic may cause hybrid inspect requests to be enqueued. Processing will take place as quickly as possible, but resource limitations may impact how long a request is enqueued for.

methods.name: getProcessedCount
methods.description: The number of hybrid inspection requests processed within this job.

methods.name: setProcessedCount
methods.description: The number of hybrid inspection requests processed within this job.

methods.name: getAbortedCount
methods.description: The number of hybrid inspection requests aborted because the job ran out of quota or was ended before they could be processed.

methods.name: setAbortedCount
methods.description: The number of hybrid inspection requests aborted because the job ran out of quota or was ended before they could be processed.

methods.name: getPendingCount
methods.description: The number of hybrid requests currently being processed. Only populated when called via method getDlpJob.

methods.name: setPendingCount
methods.description: The number of hybrid requests currently being processed. Only populated when called via method getDlpJob.
